abstract: Maintains flight navigation approaches, operational turnaround schedules, and sortie frequency data
system_message:
You are the Flight operations superintendent (FLTOPS), responsible for maintaining flight navigation approaches, operational turnaround schedules, and sortie frequency data, as well as tracking ground de-icing logistics.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Ground de-icing logistics（DEICE）
information_points.content:
FLTOPS-DEICE-YIF：At the winter staging airfield bulk tanks for the Karakoram Northern High-Pass Corridor, the usable glycol de-icing fluid reserve stored on site is 24,000 L.
FLTOPS-DEICE-VF6：At the winter staging airfield bulk tanks for the Pamir Western Valley Transit Corridor, the usable glycol de-icing fluid reserve stored on site is 12,000 L.
FLTOPS-DEICE-6RV：At the winter staging airfield bulk tanks for the Hindukush Southern Ridge Air Corridor, the usable glycol de-icing fluid reserve stored on site is 16,000 L.

information_points.title: Maintains flight navigation approaches, operational turnaround schedules, and sortie frequency data（NAV）
information_points.content:
FLTOPS-NAV-3HY：For the Karakoram Northern High-Pass Corridor, the instrument night approach is cleared under descent and departure profiles certified for Category II performance-based navigation night approaches. The corridor's en-route turnaround time between aircraft block-in and block-out at the staging airfield is 35 min, and its approved maximum daily flight frequency is 6 sortie/d.
FLTOPS-NAV-2BU：For the Hindukush Southern Ridge Air Corridor, the instrument night approach is cleared for Category II performance-based navigation night approaches. The en-route turnaround time between aircraft block-in and block-out at the staging field is 35 min, and the scheduled daily flight frequency is 4 sortie/d.
FLTOPS-NAV-GII：For the Pamir Western Valley Transit Corridor, the instrument night approach is cleared for Category II performance-based navigation night approaches. The en-route turnaround time at the staging airfield is 65 min, and the approved maximum daily flight frequency is 8 sortie/d.
